findings.detail: Stone wall, masonry joints and wooden post remain structurally continuous across the shared y12288 boundary. No displacement seen at exact four-way center.

South of center, a narrow visible transition from muted fine-brush sand on the left to bright regular mosaic marks on the right follows the side of the newer post bridge. It is visible around the foot's southwest foreground. This is a material join, not a geometry break. Current right-column proposal uses bridge with global x0=12288, leaving no native coverage to its west.

recommendedNext: After paving rebase, preserve existing new post and evaluate a wider native-ground transition around its southwest foot with both left/right current candidates as real pixel references. Mechanical cut may suffice if existing overlapping native sources provide a visually continuous path; do not approve solely from pixel replay.
